verdicts.reason: A just shrinks the whole text block into a tiny cluster in the middle. The headline is minuscule, and the subcopy, 'Only this Christmas' and the URL can't be read at all. A large empty pink area sits above it, and the photo is cropped to a sweater sleeve with no face, mug or gift. B keeps the text big enough to read, but 'GET A GIFT' and the gift icons run onto the busy sweater pattern. The alignment is all over the place: the cup is centred, the gifts are offset, the stars sit flush left and the URL is pushed against the right edge. There are also awkward line breaks ('Only this / Christmas'), which is still bad but less broken than A.
